checks: empty, malformed and excessive CoreAudio device catalog sizes are handled without borrowing an empty array pointer or changing hardware
main cancellation only invalidates a serial while actual reader cancellation remains on the worker before any stale packet copy
original stereo Float32 WAV decodes through the real four-channel engine matrix with signed gains and one clamp
post-matrix master fader scales the clipped output after its bounded render-quantum gain ramp
Pause is silent and retains the per-source sample position
generation-tagged seek flushes old PCM and clips after the complete matrix sum
rapid successive seeks cancel stale extraction completions and retain at most two queued PCM chunks
per-source zero volume and unsupported reverse direction are silent with an explicit reverse diagnostic
AVFoundation resamples original 44.1 kHz PCM to the 48 kHz graph without changing the seek region
real engine offline sample-clock drift is bounded independently of hardware latency and positive double-rate playback advances source time
original MOV first audio track is decoded and seeked through the same production PCM route
explicit source trim Out bounds PCM scheduling before the controller's next tick
natural EOF caps the reported source clock at duration and a new-generation seek resumes the correct PCM
fractional trim Out admits only samples with PTS before Out and bounds both playing and paused reported positions
global eight-source admission rejects a ninth without hardware playback, retains leases through asynchronous work and permits reuse after cancellation
limitations: No audible output, physical device routing/hotplug, speaker calibration, optical AV sync or long-show drift claim. Offline sample-clock drift is reported separately from physical output latency; reverse audio is deliberately silent.
scope: Production AVFoundation PCM extraction, per-source matrix and bounded AVAudioEngine graph in silent manual offline mode; original Float32 WAV/MOV fixtures
